messages:
Priya M.: Heads up — EdgeWave (SI) + Datadog asked for a short joint demo showing traces + token-latency widgets next Thu 11am PT. Need checklist, collector config, and a reproducible prompt set.

Leo K.: I can provide the prompt set and a tiny app that emits spans from the runtime. Will also add a `kv_cache.hit` metric as a gauge.

Hannah S.: I'll build the dashboard template: P50/P95 token latency, trace count, avg tokens/sec, recent traces table, and a small sparkline for cache hit-rate. Deliver by Wed EOD?

Priya M.: Yep. Also need a 10-minute dry-run at 10:40am on the day for screenshot capture. Who can grab the screenshot?

Leo K.: I can do screenshot and upload to marketing drive. Reminder: set OTEL sampling to always for demo.

Datadog Ops (Ryan): Quick note from Datadog — please use OTLP to `trace.agent.datadoghq.com:443`, include `DD-API-KEY` header, and keep payload sizes < 2MB per request. We'll whitelist the staging IPs you send.

edgex-bot: Deploy to staging-edgepool scheduled in 15m. Logs will appear in /var/logs/edge-demo.

Hannah S.: Ops runbook plan: firewall outbound to datadoghq:443, collector yaml with always_on sampler, env vars for cert-thumbprint for air-gapped mode, and a short rollback step. I'll add that to the dashboard PR.

Leo K.: Demo run (staging):
```bash
export OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES=\"service.name=redwood-runtime,environment=staging,host.hw_vendor=edgewave\"
export DD_API_KEY=REDACTED
./otelcol --config otel-collector-edgewave.yaml &
python demo_client.py --model redwood-7b --prompts demos/edge_prompts.txt --batch 4 --emit-spans
```

Priya M.: Owners: Leo (prompts + screenshot), Hannah (dashboard + ops runbook), Priya (announce + invite), Ryan (DD whitelist). Dry-run Thu 10:40am, demo Thu 11:00am. Post any blockers here. :rocket:
